categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`, has the Mining label, and directly modifies template update logic (`waitNext`).
categories.rationale: Switches `WaitAndCreateNewBlock` timeout measurement from `NodeClock` to `std::chrono::steady_clock` to prevent clock jumps and frozen mocktime from hanging or distorting wait durations. Correctness of template update intervals is worthwhile but this is a minor timeout edge-case fix rather than a threat to template validity.
